notes.title: New Standard Update
notes.notes:
This is the New Version 1.8.9.0.0

Featured:
*New Polish to numerous sound effects, Those are more stylish now.
*Added the option: "Load Last Check Point" to the Main Menu. That is when the player first entered the Current Area.
*And for the maps without Automatic Check Point, there has been implemented an interactive object that sets the Check Point manually.
 
Main Updates:
*More volume options for the Step Sounds, in the Title Menu.
*Added the option: "Reload the Saved Game" to the Main Menu. Reloads quickly the game from the latest saved point. 
*Added the option: "Exit without saving" to the Main Menu. For the remote case you would want to discard your current progress or position. 
*Incresed the cache limit of pictures that the game holds. 
*Poished the Title Menu with outlines and smoother translucent background colors.
*Some polish to the illumination effect on the room that has the dark maze. The room is found in the first area of the game.

Corrections:
*Added an autosave at the start of the game instead of waiting a manual action from the player.
*There was an unnecessary double fade transition in one of the firsts maps, it feels better now. (When entering the Map where the First Equipable Item is found.)
*Reworked a line of a text in a Notescreen.
*Some little retouches to a door sprite and the save point sprite.

Fixes:
*Activated the proper darkness effect when the Player starts the game in the room that has the dark maze. This happens in the first area of the game.


Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Super Update
notes.notes:
[b]This is the new content added to the game:[/b]

Mayor Improvements:
* Added 100+ emoticon reactions for when characters talk in cinematics.
* 2 new arcade machines with a unique minigame of their own
* 1 new bit-like minigame for the main campaign added
* The Secret lore to the game has been added in the form of Lost Memories! They are hidden in the game of course.

General works:
* Added a new animation effect feedback for certain power-up when they can't be used in certain areas.
* Polished some of the old emoticons, the happy face and the sad face.
* Add more polish to the curtains cinematic pictures.
* Added an effect to the main menu for when the inventory is not necessary on a map.
* Polished an introduction to a main character in the game that leads to the new minigame play.
* Numerous global detail polishes for the game, like more suitable music for certain maps and more polished dialogues.

Corrections and Glitches fixes:
* Fixed an odd glitch that inverted the Window mode and full screen mode activations.
* Fixed when the window icon used to appear checked even if the game started at full screen.

The game feels more awesome now =)

[b]Developer News:[/b]

I have to confess that i worked full time for this update, it was a lot of work.
All of the ideas that i once had for the game have been implemented, even the ones i thought i wouldn't be able to make, but with hard work it was possible.
And, finally, with that said; i want to say thanks to the people that supported the game.
It is time to move to the next project, in which, i'll be working full time of course.

The game is in its final form now, thank you for reading and: 
[i]Have nice adventures in the videogame worlds![/i]

notes.title: New Big Update
notes.notes:
[h2]This is the new content added to the game:[/h2]

[b]Map decorations and sprite animations:[/b]
* Wall decorations added for corridors.
* 5 new miscellaneous animated objects, allocated in their respective maps.
* A new miscellaneous object that reacts to the field disruptor, that also makes a starting puzzle more 
   entertaining.
* 1 new variation for the fan miscellaneous object.
* Added 4 small hologram sprites for one of the maps and a better camera focus in the respective 
   cinematic.
* More variations in the vent pipes animations and 4 of those have better placement on the map.
* More feedback sound for when certain access road is deployed in the "strange" maps.
* There is another lantern that when activated shows a room, just for show.
* A new sprite indicating when certain pc is off, so it doesn't show a hologram.

[b]Puzzles improvements:[/b]
* Added some ground textures to show better the effect that a wall has been removed in the latter 
   puzzles of the game.
* More mini game variations in the starship of exploration's arcade play, and more feedback when the 
   ship's speed is maxed out.
* More retouches to 3 of the latter puzzle maps, more interactive effects, some walls here and there 
   and reposition of musical themes.
* More feedback to one of the latter map puzzles, to make it feel better.

[b]Dialogues and NPCs:[/b]
* Added 8 more miscellaneous dialogues, 5 to the youngest sister and 3 to the older one.
* Added 3 more Miscellaneous NPCs that give a dialogues about the lore of the game.
* Better Phrasing of just one dialogue of an important NPC. (Dialogue id 571)
* Added 2 new dialogues to Nemeralda and better phrasing for an old one.
* Added 4 extra NPCs that can be found in the latter puzzle maps.

[b]Interfaces updates:[/b]
* A minor polish to the background of the "arrow" minigame and the "circular" one.
* Added some code names to the targeted celestial objects in the navigation interface.
* A more smooth launch when activating and closing the navigation interface and polished some 
   visuals of it too.
* Polished a little more the feedback effect for the after results in the exploration minigame.

[b]Cinematic updates (animations, scenes, map decorations, etc.:)[/b]
* Added a new picture scene to show the hibernating capsules in one of the cinematics of the game.
* Better timed the animation of a certain scene, to make it look smoother. ("The box's scene")
  That box now reacts a little if you interact with it.
* When that character run towards your disposition while leaving her house, she will react faster to 
   showcase that urgency. Also, the pervious cinematic scene has been polished a bit more.
* Added something extra to the longest corridor scene.
* Polished some details for one of the most elaborated cinematics at the middle of the game, (a 
   dialogue has better phrasing, a subtle flashing and some shaking screen effect)
* A small low sound feedback added when a cinematic starts and other when it ends to make feel 
   better.
* In the cinematic related to the navigator quest's item, step sounds were added to the NPCs when 
   walking towards the player.
* The overlay cinematic picture of the long corridor has a better centering now.
* Added a new weather effect that triggers for some specific cinematics.
* Two of the last cinematic scenes have now a better cinematic curtain picture effect.
* Added more decorations to the map of the final cinematic scene. 
* Added a new picture scene to one of the last cinematics of the game.

[b]Corrections and Glitches fixes:[/b]
* A small modification for an NPC triggered route if the player talks to it up front instead from a side.
* There was a dialogue in which its text canvas picture was showing space for 2 lines instead of just 1, 
   it now shows just 1 now.
* The navigation interface music theme used to restart from the beginning if the second menu was 
   closed, now that is fixed.
* It was a line of dialogue of an NPC that was missing traduction to the Spanish users, it is fixed now.
* There were 2 maps that didn't have music if the player reloaded it, it is fixed now.

[i]Thanks for your support! And have nice adventures in space![/i]
